title: Man City Faces Norwich in Carabao Cup
seoTitle: Man City vs Norwich in Carabao Cup - Title Defense Begins
subtitle: Enzo Maresca Tests New Faces Against Norwich
excerpt: The clash between Manchester City and Norwich in the Carabao Cup draws significant attention, as the defending champions' title is at stake.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The clash between Manchester City and Norwich in the Carabao Cup has been the focus of fans' attention, as the winner will advance to the fourth round of the competition, where they will face Brighton and Hove Albion. The match brings together new coach Enzo Maresca, who is testing a revamped squad, and Norwich, who are looking to reverse a series of defeats against City.

Enzo Maresca Debuts with New Players

In Maresca's debut as City's coach, he opted to start the match with three new faces: Argentine goalkeeper Rulli, Brazilian forward Allan, and forward Samba, making his professional debut. The rest of the squad includes players who stood out in the last Premier League round, such as Rayan Cherki, Rico Lewis, and Mateo Kovačić.

Head-to-Head History Between the Teams

Manchester City and Norwich last faced each other in 2022, when City won 4-0 at Carrow Road. In 2023, City defeated Norwich 5-0 at Etihad Stadium. In Norwich's last three matches against City, the aggregate score was 14-0 in favor of City.

What's at Stake for City

City, having already won the Carabao Cup last season, aims to defend the trophy. A victory guarantees entry into the fourth round, where the team will face Brighton and Hove Albion in a home game next month.

Expectations for Norwich

Norwich, who haven't beaten City in their last three matches, seeks to change the narrative. Coach Philippe Clement is betting on a tactical game, focusing on exploiting counter-attacking opportunities. Despite the setbacks, Norwich relies on players like Yongwa and Crnac to try and create chances.

Impact of Squad Changes for City

  • Rulli, Allan, and Samba make their debut as City players.
  • Phil Foden remains suspended due to a red card in the previous game.
  • Coach Maresca emphasizes the importance of maintaining discipline and seeking victories in every match.

Match Conclusion

The match between Manchester City and Norwich in the Carabao Cup highlights the battle for a spot in the competition's fourth round. City aims to retain the title won last season, while Norwich seeks to reverse a series of defeats and prove their ability to compete at a high level.

With information from BBC, Manchester City FC.
